title: Choti Diwali Krishna Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Close-up devotional darshan of blue-skinned Lord Shri Krishna, peacock-feather crown, gold jewels, yellow dhoti, gentle smile, serene face in the middle of the frame, rows of lit clay diyas glowing around him, warm festive evening
scenes.tts: छोटी दिवाली! श्री कृष्ण के दर्शन कीजिए।
scenes.sub: Choti Diwali! Shri Krishna ke darshan kijiye.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly and the golden glow gently pulses

scenes.prompt: Blue-skinned Lord Shri Krishna with his consort Satyabhama on a decorated altar, golden light, marigold garlands and many lit diyas, serene faces, festive glow
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, आज नरकासुर पर श्री कृष्ण की विजय हुई।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, aaj Narakasur par Shri Krishna ki vijay hui.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the faces stay still and serene, the diya flames flicker and soft golden light pulses

scenes.prompt: A home doorway in the evening with a row of lit clay diyas, a colourful rangoli and marigold garlands, warm golden light, no people
scenes.tts: अंधकार पर प्रकाश की जीत, इसीलिए दीप जलाते हैं।
scenes.sub: Andhkaar par prakash ki jeet, isiliye deep jalate hain.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly and a few marigold petals drift down in the warm light

scenes.prompt: Blue-skinned Lord Shri Krishna playing the flute, peacock-feather crown, standing under a starry sky, glowing diyas floating on a calm river nearby, peaceful evening
scenes.tts: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। सबके घर दीप जलें।
scenes.sub: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya. Sabke ghar deep jalein.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diyas on the water glow and drift softly

scenes.tts: कल दिवाली के दर्शन के लिए लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। जय श्री कृष्ण!
scenes.sub: Kal Diwali ke darshan ke liye Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Jai Shri Krishna!
